import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator

# Load the dataset
try:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv', low_memory=False)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Dataset not found. Please ensure 'data/dogs_zurich.csv' is in the correct directory.")
    exit()

# --- Data Preparation ---

# Filter for a recent and consistent time period (e.g., 2015 onwards)
df_recent = df[df['StichtagDatJahr'] >= 2015].copy()

# Clean breed names: Drop missing values and standardize to title case
df_recent.dropna(subset=['Rasse1Text'], inplace=True)
df_recent['Rasse1Text'] = df_recent['Rasse1Text'].str.strip().str.title()

# Identify the top 10 most popular breeds in this period
# Some breeds are listed with variations (e.g., 'Mischling Klein', 'Mischling Gross'). We'll treat them as distinct.
top_10_breeds = df_recent['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index

# Filter the dataframe to only include these top breeds
df_top_breeds = df_recent[df_recent['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_10_breeds)]

# Group by year and breed to get the annual count for each top breed
breed_trends = df_top_breeds.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'Rasse1Text']).size().reset_index(name='count')

# --- Visualization ---

# Set a modern and clear theme
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", context="talk")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create the line plot showing trends over time
sns.lineplot(
    data=breed_trends,
    x='StichtagDatJahr',
    y='count',
    hue='Rasse1Text',
    palette='viridis_r', # A colorblind-friendly palette
    linewidth=3,
    marker='o',
    markersize=8,
    ax=ax
)

# --- Formatting and Labels ---

# Set title and axis labels with descriptive text
ax.set_title('Popularity Trends of Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich (2015-Present)', fontsize=24, weight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=16, labelpad=15)
ax.set_ylabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=16, labelpad=15)

# Ensure x-axis ticks are integers for years
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True))
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=14)

# Improve the legend
handles, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(
    handles=handles,
    labels=labels,
    title='Dog Breed',
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.03, 1),
    loc='upper left',
    borderaxespad=0.,
    fontsize=12,
    title_fontsize=14,
    frameon=False
)

# Remove top and right spines for a cleaner look
sns.despine()

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from being cut off
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 1]) # Make space for the legend

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
